integrity: Proof, mathematical definitions, four primary source comparisons and a standalone standard-library exact-arithmetic checker are included; computations support rather than replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to B divisible by m and to window lengths B^(e+1), with e fixed before taking natural density. Finite prefix checks do not prove the limiting theorem. Equivalent older or unindexed probability formulas remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Scale-stationary Parikh laws for divisible-base generalized Thue–Morse words
